name: plugin-raven-verify
description: ElizaOS plugin: fetch a signed Raven receipt (receipt-v1) for a Solana mint and verify it LOCALLY against caller-pinned trusted keys before reporting facts, scope, and coverage gaps. Evidence, not a safe/unsafe verdict.
author: Raven (https://ravenattest.com)

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:dist && npm run test:package && npm run test:trust-input && npm run test:doc-contract
scripts.test:release-quality: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:dist && npm run test:package && npm run test:trust-input && npm run test:doc-contract && npm run test:mutations

RAVEN_API_KEY.description: Raven hosted-verifier API key. Request at https://raven-launch-console.vercel.app/request-access.html

RAVEN_VERIFIER_URL.description: Raven verifier base URL (override only if self-hosting).

RAVEN_TRUSTED_KEYS.description: Comma-separated base64 SPKI public keys obtained independently (pin). Required for usable evidence; unset fails closed. /pubkey must not bootstrap trust.
